comments.value:
As written this seems like a good forum post. did you also post this to ask.vrchat.com?

My understanding with the TOS is that hate groups are not allowed and so they end up being short lived. 

My main question for you, is there any particular reason you've posted this in the Open Beta specific section rather than a general feature request?

details:
I think I speak for a lot when I say I'm beyond sick of these trolls or malicious users who don't have verified accounts and they stumble upon you by whatever means to harass you. It's either that or people you've never met and honestly don't ever intend to without first having a proper interaction in-game with them. The constant notifications from random friend requests are just annoying. It's become a bit much lately and I think I know a few proper solutions. 

I think there should be a setting to only allow friend requests if you've seen the person in a world at least once or only allow a friend request to go through if the player is 18 verified. 

Another setting to add to this is a check to see if they've played so many days and if they pass a threshold (a month or more) - that allows a friend request to go through. 

I don't know if it's possible but a fine-tuning option that restricts users based on groups they're in would be nice for example (if the user sending a friend request is in any hate groups or groups that make fun of tragic historical events e.g. 9/11 - I most certainly am not friending someone who interacts or engages in such behavior) So an option that ties in with groups you've blocked to ignore/auto-deny friend requests from toxic players would be beneficial. This would really be nice because in my experience a lot of the trolls represent these groups and it would knockback their attempts to harass people.

Speaking of toxicity - I know you have a nuisance rank but let's take that and dial in a bit. How about a feature that adds a setting (toggleable) to ignore friend requests from users who have "X" number of mutes, bans, vote-kicks, moderation reports tied to their account. We don't need to know the statistics for any particular user who this applies to rather only that it's working. 

Also the notification system needs a revamp. The day and age of literally every notification flooding in the same spot is just..... yeah no thanks. Please add tabs for friend requests to be separate from other notifications. I can't count the times I've mistakenly added or declined a friend request when I'm just trying to clear out the countless group notifications I receive. 

Don't get me wrong I like having control over my account with accepting and denying notifications that come my way but the game is ever-expanding with thousands of players and I think some level of automation is needed to help manage what can at times be a bit much. Instead of wasting time sifting through a flood of nonsense notifications, I'd much rather enjoy what this game excels at - creativity and vivacious socialization - anytime something breaks the immersion of that experience their likely needs some work done to fix it.
title: 1897 (Open Beta) No more random friend requests
